review_boundary: Independent P34 resolves the exact PX0-07 package, qualification_subject_revision, later evidence_head, native/structural closure logs, Windows/Web physical observation matrices, exact platform/build/browser identities, and authorized scope before deciding whether PX0 may close.
blocking_evidence: complete native DUI/PX0 closure test evidence
Windows application build result bound to the qualification subject
Web physical-target build result bound to the qualification subject
README evidence index with exact subject/environment identities
generic debug command absence source/tree audit

identity_contract.qualification_subject_revision: Exact commit containing Task 15 test/CMake closure and no Task 16 evidence README.
identity_contract.evidence_head: Reviewer-resolvable descendant containing README/.aegis evidence only; no production or test mutation after the qualification subject.
identity_contract.rule: README and result metadata point to qualification_subject_revision; they do not recursively require evidence_head to equal the subject.

physical_observation_contract.blocking_failure_rule: Any FAIL on an expected available behavior or required input-isolation invariant is a frozen verification failure.
physical_observation_contract.unsupported_rule: Unsupported is acceptable only when current approved owner/build genuinely does not implement the control; evidence must identify the owner/availability basis.
physical_observation_contract.disabled_rule: DisabledByContext is acceptable only when the UI accurately reflects invalid current product context and the evidence records that context.

known_non_blocking_findings: Existing unrelated MSVC runtime/semantic C4702 /WX full-tree issue remains outside PX0.
PX0-06 result metadata had evidence-revision lag; PX0-07 uses explicit qualification subject versus evidence head identities to avoid repeating it.
official_claim_boundary: P32/P33 may return READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW after all blocking evidence is materialized, but may not issue PX0/P34/DUI-M1/physical/G5 PASS. If physical observations cannot be performed, return BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT instead of review readiness.
materialization_requirement: Push qualification_subject_revision and final evidence_head to refs/heads/codex/px0-07-closure-evidence or equivalently reviewer-resolvable refs. P34 must be able to resolve both identities independently.
